title: Laceration Repair Guide

changelog.change: Skeleton only. Full screen-by-screen branch logic is a build-package TODO (README 'Not yet written').

purpose: Body-region wound assessment → suture material/size and technique selection → aftercare + generated procedure note.

nodes.body: Suture size 6-0 (5-0 acceptable). Non-absorbable monofilament, or absorbable in children to avoid a removal visit. Removal 3-5 days. Primary closure window < 12-24 h. Irrigate 50-100 mL/cm.
Suture size 3-0 / 4-0; blue monofilament recommended for visibility. Staples acceptable (contraindicated on face/neck/hands/feet). Removal 7-10 days. Primary closure window < 12-24 h.
Suture size 3-0 / 4-0. Removal 6-10 days (trunk), 10-14 days over joints. Primary closure window < 6-8 h. Consider deep dermal sutures for tension.

checklist: Neurovascular and tendon exam documented before anesthesia
Local anesthetic max dose calculated — see cross-linked LA max dosing card
Irrigation 50-100 mL per cm of wound length
Wound-age cutoff for primary closure checked for this region
noteTemplate: PROCEDURE: Laceration repair, {{region}}. Wound {{length}} cm. Anesthesia: {{anesthetic}} {{anestheticVolume}} mL. Irrigation with {{irrigationVolume}} mL NS. Closure: {{sutureCount}} × {{sutureSize}} {{technique}}. Neurovascular exam intact pre- and post-procedure. Aftercare and return precautions given. Suture removal in {{removalDays}} days.
